descriptionChirho: Proper feminine noun פַּדַּן אֲרָם designating the upper Mesopotamian region around Haran where Abraham's family settled, associated with the patriarchal journeys of Jacob (Gen 25:20, 28:2, 28:5, 28:6, 28:7, 31:18, 33:18, 35:9, 35:26, 46:15). The abbreviated form מִפַּדָּן with preposition מִן (eng: from-Paddan, spa: de-Padan, arb: مِنْ–فَدَّانَ, swa: kutoka-Padani) in Gen 48:7 is the same toponym with grammatical case marking, not a separate sense.
